info.name: Cargo-Admin API
info.description:
Laravel public & authenticated API collection for Cargo-Admin (with full Elim API v1 & v2 integration). Set collection variables before running requests.

**Guest / public browsing (no Bearer token):**
- `GET /v1/public/platforms` — platforms + sliders
- `GET /v1/public/platform-sliders` — homepage banners
- `GET /v1/public/warehouses` — active Tajikistan warehouses
- `GET /v1/public/china-warehouse` — China warehouse address
- `GET /v1/public/order-statuses` — order statuses
- `GET /v1/public/taobao/products` — Taobao product listing (Elim v2)
- `GET /v1/public/taobao/products/{id}` — Taobao product find (Elim v2)
- `GET /v1/public/taobao/products/{id}/detail` — Taobao full product detail (Elim v2)
- `POST /v1/public/taobao/shipping-fee` — Taobao domestic shipping fee estimate (Elim v2)
- `GET /v1/public/1688/products` — 1688 product listing (Elim v2)
- `GET /v1/public/1688/products/{id}` — 1688 product find (Elim v2)
- `GET /v1/public/1688/products/{id}/detail` — 1688 full product detail (Elim v2)
- `GET /v1/public/utils/unshorten` — Unshorten Taobao/1688 mobile share link (`m.tb.cn`, `qr.1688.com`)
- `GET /v1/public/jd/products` — JD.com via RapidAPI
- `GET /v1/public/jd/products/{id}` — JD product detail

Supported Elim languages (`elim_lang`): `vi`, `en`, `ru`, `ko`, `ja`.

**Authenticated routes** (`/v1/auth/*`) require `Authorization: Bearer {{customer_token}}`.

**Order & Elim Payment Lifecycle (`15 - Order Lifecycle`):**
- `POST /v1/auth/{platform}/cart/preview` — previews order & captures `preview_token`
- `POST /v1/auth/{platform}/cart/checkout` — creates order (supports `preview_token`, `idempotency_key`, `client_order_id`)
- `POST /v1/auth/orders/{order}/pay` — pays from customer TJS wallet & requests Elim purchasing wallet payment
- `POST /v1/auth/orders/{order}/request-payment` — requests Elim payment on an already-paid local order
- `POST /v1/auth/orders/{order}/cancel-payment-request` — cancels a pending (`requested`) Elim payment request
- `GET /v1/auth/orders/{order}/payment` — fetches live Elim payment detail
- `POST /v1/auth/orders/{order}/sync` — syncs status & tracking from Elim (auto-refunds customer TJS wallet if upstream is `cancelled`/`refunded` or payment `rejected`)
- `POST /v1/auth/orders/{order}/refresh` — forces live upstream refresh on Elim (rate limit: 3/min per order)
- `POST /v1/auth/orders/{order}/cancel` — cancels order & credits customer TJS wallet
- `GET /v1/auth/orders/{order}/logistics` — fetches domestic China logistics tracking (`package_id` supports 20-digit Taobao package IDs)
- `GET /v1/auth/orders/elim/purchasing-wallet` & `/transactions` — Elim CNY purchasing wallet balance & ledger

**Elim Webhooks (`16 - Elim Webhooks`):**
- `POST /v1/webhooks/elim` — receives `order.updated` and `payment.updated` events verified with `X-Elim-Timestamp` and `X-Elim-Signature` (`sha256=<hmac>`).

item.name: 08 - Alif Acquiring (Add Wallet Money)
item.description:
Flutter top-up. Run Init, open payment_url, then Status.

1. **Init** — Sanctum token. Returns order_id + payment_url.
2. **Status** — poll until paid.
3. **Get Wallet** / **List Alif top-ups**.
4. **Callback** — Alif server HMAC; local tests only.

request.description: Creates a pending Alif payment and returns the hosted checkout URL. Requires customer_token.
Owner-only. If still pending, this app asks Alif checktxn and may credit the wallet.
Called by Alif, not the mobile app. Token is HMAC-SHA256 per docs.acquiring.alif.tj.

item.name: 08b - DC NEXT Acquiring (Add Wallet Money)
item.description:
Flutter top-up via DC NEXT (`invoice.dc.tj`). Run Init, open payment_url, then Status.

1. **Init** — Sanctum token. Returns order_id, invoice_id, and payment_url.
2. **Status** — poll until paid.
3. **Callback** — DC NEXT webhook (`POST /v1/webhooks/dc-next/invoice`); local tests only.

request.description: Creates a pending DC NEXT payment and returns the hosted invoice URL. Requires customer_token.
Owner-only. If still pending, this app calls DC NEXT /v1/check and may credit the wallet.
Called by DC NEXT, not the mobile app. Sign is md5(merchant + order_id + secret).

request.description: Legacy helper: nearest warehouses to a saved user address.

Each method includes two optional rate ladders. Rate `mode` is `weight` (min/max also as min_weight_g / max_weight_g) or `cm` (volumetric kg after L×W×H / volumetric_divisor). Billing is always TJS per kg.

Legacy payload: weight_kg is required. Dimensions are optional and raise chargeable weight if all three are sent. Auto uses the weight ladder if actual kg wins, otherwise the CM (volumetric) ladder. Falls back to the other ladder if the matching one is empty.
Charge by actual weight only against the Weight (g) rate ladder. Send weight_g (grams) or weight_kg. Dimensions are ignored. Falls back to CM rates if no weight rates exist.
Charge by volumetric weight only against the CM rate ladder: (L × W × H) / method volumetric_divisor. Weight is not required. Falls back to weight rates if no CM rates exist.

Charge by both actual weight (against the Weight (g) rate ladder) and volumetric weight (against the CM rate ladder). Requires both weight_g (or weight_kg) and length_cm, width_cm, height_cm. Returns package details, weight_cost_tjs, volume_cost_tjs, weight_breakdown, volume_breakdown, and combined shipping_cost.
Goods payment preview at checkout (China goods only). Cargo shipping is **not** included here; use Pickup Preview after warehouse confirms measurements.

item.name: 16 - Elim Webhooks
item.description: Webhook receiver endpoints (`POST /api/v1/webhooks/elim`) for official Elim events (`order.updated`, `payment.updated`). Includes a Pre-request Script that automatically computes `X-Elim-Timestamp` and `X-Elim-Signature` (`sha256=<hmac>`) using `{{elim_webhook_secret}}`.

request.description: Simulates an Elim `order.updated` webhook event. The pre-request script automatically signs `X-Elim-Timestamp` and `X-Elim-Signature` using `{{elim_webhook_secret}}`.
Simulates an Elim `payment.updated` rejection/cancellation webhook. Automatically marks the local order `cancelled` and credits the customer TJS wallet idempotently.
